title: With open lines Close Work Order sits in the menu, then moves to the header
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status In Progress, with one line not yet Complete.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Mark the line Complete.
  4. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The header shows no "Close Work Order" button.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Close Work Order".

Step 3:

  • "Close Work Order" shows as the header button.

Step 4:

  • The menu no longer shows "Close Work Order".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-N2: “If Create invoice would not be offered (review on and not yet marked, or every line declined), Close Work Order is not offered either. With review off and open lines, Close Work Order sits in the three-dots menu exactly as Create invoice does today; once every line is Complete it is the header button and leaves the menu, as Create invoice does.”
  • S3-R1: “On an internal or no-charge work order, every place that offers "Create invoice" on a billable work order offers "Close Work Order" instead (Title Case, like Create Work Order, the same label everywhere) and opens the confirmation of S3-R2: the header button (on mobile, the icon button with the tooltip "Close Work Order"), the three-dots menu (only while it would hold Create invoice, S3-N2), the Create invoice action on the Finance tab, the finish action of the lines bulk bar, and the completion wizard of Simple Mode wherever it offers Create invoice (on these work orders the wizard shows no core amount and no "to invoice" wording). No path on these work orders creates a billable invoice. "Mark Reviewed" is unchanged.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
